Your lines, together

Portfolio

Accounts for overlap between your lines. Small problems are counted exactly; larger ones use a simulation with an uncertainty interval.

Repeating lines in the same draw does not create new coverage. Repeating across different draws is a separate calculation.

Selection coverage

Payout scenario

OPTIONAL

Enter assumed payouts for mutually exclusive match categories to calculate expected net return per line. Blank entries mean R0. Actual payouts, prize sharing and retailer fees can change the result. This is a scenario, not a profit forecast. For add-ons, it counts only the selected draw’s payouts but the full required ticket cost.

Rules & data

Six current South African draw games are included. The custom mode supports other unordered single-pool and two-pool games. Legacy formats are for historical analysis only. Raffles, sports pools, scratch cards and ordered digit games are not modelled.

Current presets checked on 10 October 2026 against authorised lottery retailers. No live results or jackpot feed is connected. Confirm rules and fees before entering a draw.
